items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: We also got a piano player, a woman piano player, played with us. We picked up in Pensacola, Florida. What was her name? Helen

ctx.x: We went to Pensacola with Buddy, Petit, Chani, we had Ray Chani on drums, we had Al Morgan on bass,

Earl Lumpfords, trombone, clarinet. Little fella, I can't think of his last name. His name was Manny. That's all I can think of. What did you mention? Banjo player. He was a kid too, by the way. We had to get permission from his father to take him along with us. And what happened over there? Well, we stayed there for quite a while and I think it got a little tough. Buddy Petit came back to New Orleans, Earl Lumpfords came back. So we got another trumpet player by the name of her, Mac Thomas, to play trumpet. And…
Was she related to Sadie? You know Sadie that used to play around here? She might have come after you left. Sadie Goodson, Clarice Goodson. She's a New York man, but you might have known.
